Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Alok Jain
Present: Mr. A.D.S. Jattana, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Amandeep Singh Samra, Aag, Punjab.

The present petition is for grant of regular bail to the petitioner in case FIR No.18 dated 09.01.2025 (Annexure P-1), under Sections 376, 384, 506 and 34 of IPC and Section 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012, registered at Police Station Zirakpur, District SAS Nagar (Mohali), in which final report under Section 173 of Cr.P.C. dated 01.04.2025 (Annexure P-2) stands filed.
2. Custody certificate filed by the learned State counsel is taken on record.
3. At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner prays for withdrawal of the present petition.
4. In light of the above, the present petition is dismissed as withdrawn without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case.
